caption: The screen Welcome back of Tapstitch (tapstitch.com/login) to which the Shopify app sent us right after the install: Sign in with Google, a field for e-mail, a field for password, the button Sign in and the link Sign up, with a cookie banner (We value your privacy, Accept All, Customise) over the lower part and a photo of folded T-shirts with a neck label on the right. The photo shows no person.

The designer of Tapstitch with the Essential Cotton T-Shirt in black: the tab Mockup on the left with a small preview, the canvas in the middle with the text layer text1 in the WordArt style that shows add text here in red (the own text Test Brand was typed but not taken over), the buttons Front, Back, Left Sleeve and Right Sleeve, the note that mockups are for reference only, Total Price: EUR 8.06+ and the button Save Design at the top. The design was not saved.

The same designer with the Total Price list open at the top right: Blank garment EUR 5.45, + Print Front EUR 2.61 ~ EUR 3.04, Total Price EUR 8.06 ~ EUR 8.49 and the line *Excluding shipping and taxes. The list is half see-through over the Attributes panel.

The Size Guide pop-up on the product page of the Essential Cotton T-Shirt, with the tabs Inches and Centimeters (Centimeters open): length, shoulder, chest and sleeve length for S to 3XL (XL: chest 57.5, S: chest 50, 3XL: chest 62.5), the line that actual measurements may vary by 1 to 3 cm (0.4 to 1.2 in) and the start of How to Measure. The header with the account initials was cut off before we kept the image.
